newsitem.title: UK: Bunzl says acquires Canadian business.
newsitem.headline: Bunzl says acquires Canadian business.

text.p: International paper and plastics group Bunzl Plc said on Monday it had acquired RAP-ID Paper and Restaurant Supply Ltd, a leading paper and plastic disposables distributor with eight branches in western and central Canada.
Sales for the group in the year to May 1996 were 53 million Canadian dollars.
The acquisition follows the purchase of Tryverse Products and Dorfin Distribution near Toronto in July 1996.

"With the earlier acquisition in the eastern part of Canada, the addition of RAP-ID Paper creates a broad Canadian platform on which to build a distribution business similar to our extremely successful operation in the United States," said Bunzl chairman Anthony Habgood.
